preconditions.description: The number of votes is between 1 and 1000.
Each vote string has a length between 1 and 26.

preconditions.expression: all(len(vote) == len(votes[0]) for vote in votes)
preconditions.description: All vote strings have the same length.

preconditions.expression: all(vote[i] in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for vote in votes for i in range(len(vote)))
preconditions.description: Each character in the vote strings is an uppercase English letter.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(vote)) == len(vote) for vote in votes)
preconditions.description: All characters in each vote string are unique.

preconditions.expression: all(char in votes[0] for char in votes[0])
preconditions.description: All characters that occur in the first vote string also occur in all other vote strings.

postconditions.expression: return_value == ''.join(sorted(votes[0], key=lambda team: tuple(-votes.count(vote) for vote in votes[0] if vote[i] == team) + (team,)))
postconditions.description: The returned string is the sorted list of teams according to the ranking system.
